headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Deckers (DECK) Upgraded 2027 Guidance And Teva Product Expansion
summary: Earlier this month, Deckers Outdoor reported first-quarter 2026 sales of US$1,019.53 million with net income of US$129.97 million, and raised its full-year fiscal 2027 guidance to net sales of US$5.86–5.91 billion, operating margin slightly above 21.5%, and diluted EPS of US$7.35–7.50, assuming share repurchases equal to roughly 80% of projected free cash flow. headline: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) Could Be 18% Undervalued As Revenue Topped $1b
summary: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) has drawn fresh attention after reporting first quarter revenue of US$1.02b, crossing the US$1b mark, while lifting full year earnings guidance and outlining continued investment in its HOKA and UGG franchises.
